subject: history
topicName: Depth Study: a Period in Detail

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Chronology: precise dates, sequence, duration, contemporaneity

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Key figures: biography, ideology, agency, constraints, legacy, historiographical reputation

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Significance: immediate impact, long-term consequences, symbolic importance, scale/depth

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Nuanced argument: avoid determinism; weigh multiple factors; qualify judgements

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Assess the significance of Lenin in the Bolshevik consolidation of power 1917-1924 --- Solution: Crucial: April Theses redirected party; Oct Revolution leadership; Treaty of Brest-Litovsk (pragmatism); War Communism/NEP (ideological flexibility); suppressed opposition (Cheka, ban on factions). But: structural factors (war, economic collapse, peasant resistance) also critical. Historiography: Service (central) vs Figes (contingent)

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Create timeline of key events 1917-1924 | Evaluate role of Trotsky vs Lenin | Debate: was NEP betrayal or necessity?
